questions.question: Is accessible parking available?
questions.answer: Yes. Accessible parking is available near the venue entrance.

evidence.excerpt: Accessible parking is available for visitors near the venue entrance.

questions.question: Is there a step-free route into the venue?
questions.answer: Yes. A continuous level route is available from the west gate to the main entrance.

evidence.excerpt: A level route is available from the west gate to the main entrance.

questions.question: Are the main public doors wide enough?
questions.answer: The main public doors have a clear opening of at least 900mm.

evidence.excerpt: The main public doors provide a clear opening of at least 900mm.

questions.question: Is there an accessible viewing platform?
questions.answer: Yes. An accessible viewing platform is planned in front of the Main Stage.

evidence.excerpt: An accessible viewing platform is planned in front of the Main Stage.

questions.question: Are accessible restrooms available?
questions.answer: Yes. Accessible toilets are available within the main arena.

evidence.excerpt: Accessible toilets are available within the main arena.

questions.question: Can visitors ask staff for accessibility help?
questions.answer: Yes. Visitors can ask the event team for help at the entrance, and stewards can guide people to accessible facilities or quieter areas during the event.

evidence.excerpt: Visitors can ask the event team for help at the entrance, and stewards can guide people to accessible facilities.
